# Competency and Resume Interview

[← IBM](../README.md) · [Every IBM question](../../ibm.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/competency-and-resume-interview)

`bq` `deep-dive` `star` `why-company`

---

## Format

Video competency round:

- Five prompts.
- One minute of preparation for each prompt.
- Three minutes to respond to every prompt.

Sample prompts:

- Describe a team project that went particularly well. What role did you take, and how did you contribute to the outcome?
- Recall a situation where being prepared made a difference. What were you doing?

Live co-op / SDE interview prompts:

- Your greatest strength.
- A situation in which you failed to meet a deadline.
- Why IBM?
- Why are you interested in this position?
- Follow-up questions about resume projects: why you chose the project, how you created it, and which technologies you used.

## Observations

- The live session can last 40–60 minutes, involve two interviewers, and contain no coding.
- Resume follow-ups generally are not detailed architecture examinations; they center on your motivation, ownership, and whether you genuinely used the technologies you listed.

## Preparation

- Develop four STAR stories with measurable results: a successful team effort, a situation where preparation helped, a missed deadline, and a conflict or ambiguous situation. Limit each response to less than three minutes.
- For `Why IBM?`, tie the particular position to IBM’s products or client setting and to your project background; do not give a broad prestige-based response.
- For resume deep dives, select two projects and practice explaining why you created them, what you personally did, a trade-off you made, and one defect or failure you managed.
